dialogues.speaker: Sylvie
dialogues.text: The Callas Line heads northward, toward the Fontaine Research Institute. The Navia Line heads to Erinnyes in the east, and the Clementine Line, the Romaritime Harbor in the south.

dialogues.speaker: Sylvie
dialogues.text: The Melusine tour guides on board will introduce you to the unique sights of our land, so stay tuned.
